# Public photograph used only by synthetic acceptance tests

`grace_hopper.jpg` is copied byte-for-byte from the official Matplotlib
repository, pinned tag `v3.9.0`:

https://github.com/matplotlib/matplotlib/blob/v3.9.0/lib/matplotlib/mpl-data/sample_data/grace_hopper.jpg

SHA-256: `a8ca6d734765703b09728ab47fe59f473d93ae3967fc24c7c0288c3c7adb7130`.

The photograph depicts Commodore Grace M. Hopper. Original attribution:
James S. Davis, U.S. Navy, 20 January 1984, photograph ID `DN-SC-84-05971`.
The original file record identifies it as a public-domain U.S. government work:

https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Commodore_Grace_M._Hopper,_USN_(covered).jpg

Matplotlib's project license is available at:
https://github.com/matplotlib/matplotlib/blob/v3.9.0/LICENSE/LICENSE
Copyright (c) 2012– Matplotlib Development Team; All Rights Reserved.

This asset is used solely to exercise the real local OpenCV face-presence
signal and source-bound photo derivation in synthetic PDFs. The tests resize or
crop it inside new synthetic originals; the retained JPEG is unchanged. No
claim associates the pictured public figure with any synthetic roster identity,
team, age, tournament participation or eligibility. No player/source photograph
from operational data is used, and no image is uploaded to a model or service.
